Context: 1. Voluntary Retirement

Whenever a Government servant seeks voluntary retirement citing medical grounds, or when the said YRS notice has been submitted due to a disability, the Administrative Authorities shall examine as to whether the case is covered under Section 20 (4) of RPWD Act, 2016. In case the provisions are applicable, the Government servant shall be advised that he/she has the option of continuing in service with the same pay scale and service benefits.
